# Setup


## R library and data input

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(viridis)

theme_set(theme_classic())
data_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_processed_data"
```

# Load data

## Load sample information

These sample information were generated by taking the intersection of TCR data and mutation data.

```{r}
sample_info_mut = fread(file.path(data_dir, "sample_info_mutations.tsv"))
dim(sample_info_mut)
sample_info_mut[1:2,]

summary(sample_info_mut$n_non_silent_mut/sample_info_mut$n_mut)
sort(table(sample_info_mut$cancer_type))

sample_info = fread(file.path(data_dir, "sample_info.tsv"))
dim(sample_info)
sample_info[1:2,]

summary(sample_info$abundance)

sample_ins = merge(sample_info, sample_info_mut)
dim(sample_ins)
sample_ins[1:2,]

fwrite(sample_ins, file.path(data_dir, "sample_info_intersection.tsv"), 
       sep= "\t")
```

## Check the association between mutation burden and the amount of T cells

```{r}
# T_stroma means the proportion of T cells among stroma (or non-tumor cels)
sample_ins$T_stroma = sample_ins$T_cell_prop/(1 - sample_ins$purity)

cor(sample_ins$n_non_silent_mut, sample_ins$T_cell_prop)
cor(sample_ins$n_non_silent_mut, sample_ins$purity)
cor(sample_ins$n_non_silent_mut, sample_ins$T_stroma, use="pair")

sample_ins$mutation_burden = log10(sample_ins$n_non_silent_mut + 1)

ggplot(sample_ins, aes(x=mutation_burden, y=T_stroma, color=purity)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) + 
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", 
                        midpoint = 0.5) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.6, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") + 
  geom_abline(intercept = 0.37, slope = 0.2, color="black", linetype = "dashed")

w2check = which(sample_ins$T_stroma > 0.6 & 
                  sample_ins$T_stroma > 0.37 + 0.2*sample_ins$mutation_burden)
table(sample_ins$cancer_type[w2check])

sample_ins$THYM = sample_ins$cancer_type == "THYM"
ggplot(sample_ins, aes(x=mutation_burden, y=T_stroma, color = THYM)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=0.8) 

cor(sample_ins$n_non_silent_mut[!sample_ins$THYM], 
    sample_ins$T_stroma[!sample_ins$THYM], use="pair")

ggplot(data = subset(sample_ins, !THYM), 
       mapping = aes(x = mutation_burden, y = T_stroma)) +
  geom_pointdensity() +
  scale_color_viridis()

cr1 = by(sample_ins, sample_ins$cancer_type, 
          function(df) cor(df$mutation_burden, df$T_stroma, use="pair"))
cr_df = data.frame(cancer_type = names(cr1), corr=as.numeric(cr1))
cr_df = cr_df[order(cr_df$corr),]
cr_df$cancer_type = factor(cr_df$cancer_type, levels = cr_df$cancer_type)

ggplot(cr_df, aes(x=cancer_type, y=corr)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="seagreen") +  theme_bw() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 70, hjust = 1)) 
```
